// @path: src/app/ops/families/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-BANNED-IDENTIFIER
// Reading a family code is signing in as that family. Amendment C1.
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";
import { lookupFamily } from "@/lib/ops/reads";

export default async function FamilyPage({ searchParams }) {
  await requireOperator();
  const family = await lookupFamily(searchParams.email);
  return <p>{family.familyCode}</p>;
}
